date.as_written: samvat 713 jeṣṭha kṛṣṇa tṛtīyāyāṃ utrāṣāḍha (!) nakṣatra budhavāra

notes: The manuscript was originally copied in NS 713 by Jayantarājadeva for King Jagajjyotirmalladeva of Bhaktapur. A secondary note records an event or inspection in NS 808 (Śrāvaṇa vadi 13) under King Sumati Jayajitāmitramalladeva during the tenure of the paramāna (officer/pramāṇa) Bhāgīrāma, whom the catalogue incorrectly listed as the scribe.
